prompt: The mean of $\{6, 8, 10, 12\}$ is $9$. If you add $4$ to **each** value, what is the new mean?
hint: Adding the same number to every value shifts the mean by that number.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sort the data from least to greatest first — many statistics get easy after that.
Adding the same number to every value shifts the mean by that number.

explanation: Adding a constant to every value shifts the mean by the same constant.
